description: Unit test class for the Condition class in the OpenMRS project, testing the behavior of the matches() method and equality checks between Condition instances.

classes.name: ConditionTest
classes.description: Test suite for the Condition class, focusing on the matches() method and comparing different Condition instances for equality and changes.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Initializes a base Condition object with various fields set up for use in subsequent tests.

methods.name: matches_shouldReturnFalseIfNoFieldsHaveChanged
methods.description: Verifies that two identical Condition instances match each other when no fields have been changed.

methods.name: matches_shouldReturnFalseIfOnlyIdentityFieldsHaveChanged
methods.description: Checks that changing only identity fields (id, uuid) does not cause the match to fail.

methods.name: matches_shouldReturnTrueIfNonIdentityFieldsHaveChanged
methods.description: Verifies that changes to non-identity fields (condition details, dates, status, etc.) cause the match to fail, and reverting them causes a match.
